messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a preflight rollout for the new quantized kernel (ABI v3). Canary window scheduled to start in ~15m for a small pool (3 hosts). Outline below, pls ack. :eyes:
- Canary targets: host-3, host-7, host-9
- Image: rwdw/rt:2.11-quant-abi3
- Rollout start: 2026-03-20 17:30 UTC (deploy-bot will trigger)
- Acceptance gates: perf, errors, mem OOM, eval diffs

jeff: ACK. I will watch latency dashboards and set temporary alerts. what's exact rollback trigger? :thumbsup:

maria: Rollback triggers I care about:
- p50 increase >20% over baseline for 5m
- error rate >0.5% (5m window) or any OOMs
- regression on our core reranker eval set > 0.3 BLEU-like diff (see eval job)
If any of these fire, we rollback immediately. Rollback command:
```
deploy-bot rollback --release=quant-kernel-abi-v3 --scope=canary
```

anita: Added a quick smoke/e2e job that runs on canary hosts: /ci/quant-smoke.sh (10 queries). It uploads logs to s3://redwood-ci/quant-smoke/1801. Will post link after first run.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout at 1801240200. Notifying oncall @samir. Canary group: small-quant-abi-v3 (3 hosts).

samir: oncall here — I'll open a trace watch and set a p50/p95 anomaly alert + a manual slack page at +15m post-start. If I see bad tails I'll escalate.

jeff: We should pin the runtime variant for any callers that have tight KV cache expectations — point them to runtime:2.11-quant. Where do we set that pin?

maria: Update the service config in /infra/services/serving/configs/runtime_pins.yaml. snippet:
```yaml
# runtime_pins.yaml
serving-api: 
  model_runtime: "rwdw/rt:2.11-quant"
  allowed_abis: ["abi3"]
```

deploy-bot: Canary started on host-3, host-7, host-9. Containers pulled image rwdw/rt:2.11-quant-abi3. Healthchecks: liveness + kvcache smoke.

host-7 (anita): quick metric snapshot after 2m: p50 15ms (baseline 11ms), p95 48ms (baseline 44ms). error-rate 0.02%. No OOMs.

anita: I ran the reranker smoke — noticed a subtle scoring delta on 3/100 queries. Logging full diffs to the eval bucket. Not sure yet if model or kernel.

jeff: if we see a quality regression that tracks to kernel, we should hold and not promote. If it's model-level, we can still proceed. Keep eval diffs coming.

maria: If immediate rollback needed, use emergency shortcut:
```
deploy-bot emergency-rollback --group=small-quant-abi-v3
```
This tears down canary and reverts image on hosts.

deploy-bot: Canary health checks steady at +10m. 3/3 healthy. No OOMs. p50 uptick noted but within threshold.

samir: +1 from oncall, but I'll keep pager blocked for 40m.

jeff: Kicked off the full perf-regression job across the shard (job/quant-perf-full-1801). ETA ~20m.

anita: Perf job partial results: tail latency distribution looks fine, small median bump only. Eval diffs: 3 small cases flagged, not clear if infra. I'm running a reproducer on debug host.

maria: Please add a release-note bullet: "kernel: quant ABI v3 — reduced memory use; requires runtime >=2.11-quant. See CHANGELOG link: https://internal/redwood/releases/quant-abi-v3"

jeff: I also requested a temporary feature flag to disable the new kernel per-service in case of partial failure. Flag name: flags.runtime.quant_abi_v3.

anita: Added that flag and set default = enabled for canary namespace. Docs updated in the canary runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary completed at 1801240400. 3/3 hosts healthy. Promoting to staged in 30m unless a rollback is requested.

maria: Thanks everyone. If no objections by 1801240700 we promote. @devex please stitch release notes. @security check KMS access path for the new image signing. :pray:

samir: No objections from oncall. I'll stand down after promote window if perf jobs look good.

jeff: LGTM. Will monitor for another 20m.

anita: Reproducer found the eval diffs are due to tokenizer edge-case — leaving note in the eval run. Not a kernel bug, so I'm fine promoting after staged guard. :white_check_mark:

maria: Great — promoting plan proceeds. After staged I'll run a limited main rollout with 10% traffic for 1hr. Any last calls?

jeff: nope. :thumbsup:

anita: all clear from my side.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled to staged at 1801240700. Will proceed unless a rollback message appears in this thread.
